mapper.select: select from basket_event_team where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
select from basket_event_team where is_delete = 0 order by id desc

select et.id, et.season_id, se.display_title as season_title, et.division_id, d.division_name, et.platform_code, et.registration_id, et.source_team_id, et.team_name_snapshot, et.team_logo_file_id, et.team_short_name, et.captain_player_id, coalesce(p.game_nickname, mp.nickname) as captain_player_name, et.event_team_no, et.event_team_status, et.create_time from basket_event_team et left join basket_season se on se.id = et.season_id and se.is_delete = 0 left join basket_division d on d.id = et.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = et.captain_player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = et.captain_member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 where et.is_delete = 0 and et.id = #{id} and et.season_id = #{seasonId} and et.division_id = #{divisionId} and et.source_team_id = #{sourceTeamId} and et.team_name_snapshot like concat('%', #{teamNameSnapshot}, '%') order by et.id desc
select from basket_event_team where division_id = #{divisionId} and source_team_id = #{sourceTeamId} and is_delete = 0 limit 1

season_id = #{seasonId}, division_id = #{divisionId}, registration_id = #{registrationId}, source_team_id = #{sourceTeamId}, team_name_snapshot = #{teamNameSnapshot}, team_logo_file_id = #{teamLogoFileId}, team_short_name = #{teamShortName}, captain_player_id = #{captainPlayerId}, captain_member_id = #{captainMemberId}, event_team_no = #{eventTeamNo}, event_team_status = #{eventTeamStatus}, platform_code = #{platformCode}, update_time = now()
where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
